initiative: Artificial Life, Emergent Intelligence, and Digital Organisms
proposed_mechanism: Causal feedback between constituent degradation and internal replacement
critical_null_control: Internal repair process removed with equivalent resource conditions
falsifier: Repairs persist identically after the internal feedback loop is disabled

initiative: Artificial Life, Emergent Intelligence, and Digital Organisms
proposition: Compositional inheritance can transmit novel field functions
proposed_mechanism: Locally embedded rule parameters passed from parent to daughter
critical_null_control: Shuffled offspring parameters and parent links
falsifier: Trait fidelity is no higher than shuffled/environment-only control

initiative: Artificial Life, Emergent Intelligence, and Digital Organisms
proposition: Resource co-dependence generates functional ecological niches
proposed_mechanism: Cross-feeding and resource-byproduct coupling under spatial limits
critical_null_control: Single-resource world with same total resource input and computation
falsifier: New repertoire is explained only by larger resource supply

initiative: Artificial Life, Emergent Intelligence, and Digital Organisms
proposition: Modular hereditary encodings improve reachable functional complexity
proposed_mechanism: Viable mutational paths via reusable genetic-developmental modules
critical_null_control: Monolithic and modular representations at matched genotype/compute budgets
falsifier: Only module count rises while new independently graded functions do not

initiative: Artificial Life, Emergent Intelligence, and Digital Organisms
proposition: Ecological heterogeneity can select useful sensing without assigned tasks
proposed_mechanism: Viability advantage for predictive internal state in changing environments
critical_null_control: Temporal cue shuffle and static-resource control without sensing bonus
falsifier: Cue-state alteration does not change viability or information-seeking actions

initiative: Artificial Life, Emergent Intelligence, and Digital Organisms
proposition: Endogenous repairable boundaries enable new ecological strategies
proposed_mechanism: Repair of constituent-defined boundary rather than engine-enforced wall
critical_null_control: Engine-defined protected boundaries and knockout of internal repair
falsifier: Unprotected populations only collapse, or no functional strategy advantage appears

initiative: Artificial Life, Emergent Intelligence, and Digital Organisms
proposition: Organism-modified niches sustain more functional innovation
proposed_mechanism: Feedback from agents consuming/producing resources alters selection
critical_null_control: Freeze organism effects; use matched exogenous environment forcing
falsifier: Continued novel function rate unchanged when niche construction removed

initiative: Artificial Life, Emergent Intelligence, and Digital Organisms
proposition: Process identity outperforms pixel identity under active repair
proposed_mechanism: Persistent causally relevant constituent interaction networks
critical_null_control: Oscillator/vortex controls and pixel-overlap tracker, blinded splitting
falsifier: Persistent inert attractors classified as organisms or repaired lineages missed

initiative: Artificial Life, Emergent Intelligence, and Digital Organisms
proposition: Evolvable variation strategies increase functional evolvability
critical_null_control: Matched fixed mutation-rate and global variation budget
falsifier: Only mutation volume rises; descendants show no durable new capabilities

initiative: Artificial Life, Emergent Intelligence, and Digital Organisms
proposition: Visual novelty and functional innovation can decouple
proposed_mechanism: Aesthetic/embedding exploration differs from viability-grounded novelty
critical_null_control: External visual score removed and function tests hidden from optimizer
falsifier: Visually new forms never acquire counterfactually validated capabilities

initiative: Artificial Life, Emergent Intelligence, and Digital Organisms
proposition: Hereditary program plus spatial physics may enable heritable morphogenesis
proposed_mechanism: Inheritable programs regulate spatial development, rather than fixed image reward
critical_null_control: Matched pure-instruction ecology and pure-field controls
falsifier: No offspring fidelity or novel functional repair at equal compute

initiative: Artificial Life, Emergent Intelligence, and Digital Organisms
proposition: More organization can reduce fitness under severe resource scarcity
proposed_mechanism: Maintenance cost selects against gratuitous complexity
critical_null_control: Vary scarcity; compare forced complexity score against absent score
falsifier: Complexity pressure never incurs additional viability cost in tested environments

initiative: Artificial Life, Emergent Intelligence, and Digital Organisms
proposition: A causality-aware process-lineage tracker detects genuinely independent distributed offspring more reliably than spatial connected-component identity.
proposed_mechanism: Minimal necessary predecessor edges across disjoint clusters permit branching causal identity without false shape-only positives.
critical_null_control: Periodic glider, oscillator, glider-gun and noncausal lookalikes under blinded lineage tracking.
falsifier: Method classifies cyclic/unbranching patterns as reproducing or does not generalize to a second deterministic CA rule.

initiative: Artificial Life, Emergent Intelligence, and Digital Organisms
proposition: Endogenous heritable changes to a program interpreter allow viable new ecological functions that are inaccessible to matched fixed-language mutations.
proposed_mechanism: Changes in semantics alter reachable construction and action space while being copied through an organism-like lineage.
critical_null_control: Fixed interpreter with same compute, human-injected opcode changes, neutral random semantic scrambling, syntax-only changes and lineage shuffle.
falsifier: New semantic operators fail viable transmission or do not confer independently assayed new functional capabilities beyond controls.

initiative: Artificial Life, Emergent Intelligence, and Digital Organisms
proposition: Measuring causal self-maintenance, viability-directed regulation, and independently observed adaptive novelty as separate axes rejects simulation artifacts more reliably than a single apparent-aliveness score.
proposed_mechanism: Orthogonal null tests expose false inferences from passive pattern persistence, external fitness shaping and designer repair.
critical_null_control: Static oscillator, engine reset, cosmetic energy signal, shuffled survival cue, externally optimized visual novelty benchmark.
falsifier: Separate criteria still identify these null systems as possessing the same maintenance, agency and adaptation properties as intended study cases.
